title: Anytime Solver Evaluation with a Normalized Signed Primal Integral and Explicit Reference Policies - Extended Version
summary: Anytime solvers return usable solutions before they terminate and improve them while time remains. Their progress is commonly summarized by a primal integral, a final gap, or convergence curves. Each summary leaves consequential choices open: how to score a run before its first feasible solution, whether poor incumbents are truncated, and whether the reference value is updated after the experiment or version-frozen beforehand.
